determination: The original two-arm ATR proposal lacks a durable complete prospective parameter freeze; the later three-bucket proposal conflicts with it. The development data already exposed conditional counts. Neither proposal authorizes economic selection or implementation. Keep the regime family open as exploratory, defer independent confirmation until genuinely disjoint eligible data and a prospective freeze exist. Continue frontier-level discovery on a distinct open mechanism using existing pre-outcome feasibility and 13W M5 data, with cost authority acquired only for a specific prospective envelope.
prohibitions: Do not treat the exploratory counts as independent confirmation or rank a winning arm/symbol.
Do not repeat C032 or consume an attempt for scope recovery.
Do not close the regime or carry families on data-prerequisite grounds.
